name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics and Further Mathematics (Further Maths A level only); IB Analysis and Approaches; Colleges usually require A* in Maths and/or Further Maths, sometimes A*/7 in Physics
notes: Mathematics with Statistics Part II/III; Cambridge Statistical Laboratory world-leading; strong in probability theory and Bayesian analysis

name: University of Warwick
typicalOffer: A*A*A, A*A* in Mathematics and Further Mathematics (with Further Maths)
notes: 3-year BSc or 4-year MMathStat Mathematics and Statistics; Warwick Statistics is globally top-10; strong in stochastic processes, Bayesian stats and financial mathematics

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: A*A*A*-A*AB, including Mathematics at A* (Further Mathematics preferred)
notes: 4-year BSc (Hons) Mathematics and Statistics; Scottish 4-year Honours; Maxwell Institute; strong in Bayesian inference and statistical computing; excellent data science career links

name: University of Southampton
notes: 4-year MMath Mathematics with Statistics; Southampton Statistical Sciences Research Institute; strong in survey methodology and medical statistics

name: University of Bath
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A*A in Mathematics and Further Mathematics
notes: 4-year MMath Mathematics and Statistics; excellent actuarial and financial industry links; Bath's placement year highly valued by data employers

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Mathematics and A in another mathematics-related subject (Biology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Economics or Physics); alternatively A*AA including A*A in Maths and Further Maths
notes: 4-year MSci Mathematics and Statistics; strong biostatistics and Bayesian methods; Bristol Centre for Statistics; links to medical research and pharmaceutical companies

name: University of Glasgow
notes: 4-year BSc (Hons) Mathematics and Statistics; Scottish 4-year Honours; Maxwell Institute; strong in medical statistics and NHS clinical research links
courseName: Mathematics and Statistics & Data Analytics BSc (Hons)

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAA-AAB, including a minimum of grade A in Mathematics
notes: 4-year MMath Mathematics and Statistics; strong biostatistics and Bayesian analysis; Leeds Statistical Science Group; pharmaceutical industry and NHS links
